Class Presence

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.slotkit.api.Presence
public final class Presence extends Object
What the other side runs, as the handshake found it when the player joined.

A mod declares its sides in fabric.mod.json ("custom": { "slotkit": { "bothSides": "required" } }, or "preferred"); the handshake lists every declaring mod and every slot-state channel, so either side can ask about them here. Decided before the world loads, fixed until disconnect, reset at the next configuration. In singleplayer every answer is true for every mod in the game. Read it when you build your UI, or on Fabric's ClientPlayConnectionEvents.JOIN; there is no extra event. 

// Gray out a shared setting the server can't hold.
toggle.disabledWhen(() -> !Presence.serverHasChannel(MY_CHANNEL_ID));

A client's answer about itself is its claim: it decides what the server sends it and whether it is admitted, never whether a write is allowed.
